main.description: Captioning preferences for a streamer's content. Travels with the metadata configuration into every minted segment, so relays see the same policy as the origin.

canonical.description: How the canonical caption track is produced. auto (the default when absent): the origin node transcribes speech and masters a caption track into the canonical stream. ingest: the streamer supplies canonical captions at ingest (CEA-608/708 embedded in the video, or place.stream.caption.pushCaptions) and nodes do not transcribe. off: the canonical stream carries no captions.

allowNodeCaptions.description: Whether nodes may generate and distribute their own captions for accessibility when the canonical stream has none. Absent means allowed.

languages.description: Spoken languages of the content, most prominent first. A hint for speech recognition; absent means detect automatically.
